column1: # Loanwords in spoken Armenian -> what goes in their place before translation. See glossary.py.
# Format: target<TAB>spelling, spelling[<TAB>near=word, word; then=word, word]
#   The optional third column is a context rule: the word is only replaced when a `near` word is within 3 words,
#   or the next word is a `then` word. Use it for spellings that are also ordinary Armenian words (փուլ, փուշ).
#   `noboost` in the third column keeps a spelling out of ASR phrase boosting (see asr.py).
#   Latin target   = English word, shown in the Armenian line and sent to NLLB.
#   Armenian target = plain Armenian equivalent of a Russian word, sent to NLLB only; the screen shows what was said.
# Spellings are how the ASR model is expected to write the word by sound. Most are educated guesses: check the
# text_hy_asr column of logs/latency_<run>.csv and add the spellings the model really produces.
# Left out on purpose: loans NLLB already knows as Armenian words (ինտերնետ, կոմպյուտեր, ֆայլ, նորմալ, պրոբլեմ is
# kept below because it is colloquial), and spellings that are also common Armenian words with no clear context
# (պլան = plan, սաղ = all/alive): replacing them would break normal sentences.
